q: What CBAM figure should an EU buyer ask for on aluminium from Tema?
title: Tema aluminium smelter: CBAM figure
short: Direct emissions only: anode carbon consumed, perfluorocarbons from anode effects, and fuel for casting. A smelter running only part of its potlines should report per tonne actually produced in the period, because fixed loads spread over fewer tonnes.
audience: The Ghanaian aluminium smelter, traders and EU buyers of its metal

ul: Fuel for holding furnaces and casting.

p: Anode effects and heat losses per tonne can be higher when a smelter restarts or runs few potlines. Report the period and lines operating.
Reported, not charged. Power from hydro and gas gives a lower indirect figure than coal based smelters, which buyers may value.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
